# Zellij

> Zellij is a workspace and terminal multiplexer written in Rust, with support for multiple panes, tabs, and a WebAssembly plugin system for extending its functionality.

Zellij runs on Linux, macOS, and via a web client. It ships opinionated defaults out of the box (a status bar, pane/tab management, layouts) while remaining fully configurable through KDL config files and layouts.

- [Installation](https://zellij.dev/documentation/installation): How to install Zellij on various platforms

- [Configuration](https://zellij.dev/documentation/configuration): How Zellij's configuration system works
- [Configuration options](https://zellij.dev/documentation/options): Full list of configuration options
- [Keybindings](https://zellij.dev/documentation/keybindings): Default keybindings and modes
- [Rebinding keys](https://zellij.dev/documentation/rebinding-keys): How to customize keybindings
- [Layouts](https://zellij.dev/documentation/layouts): Defining and using layouts
- [Creating a layout](https://zellij.dev/documentation/creating-a-layout): Step-by-step layout authoring
- [Layout examples](https://zellij.dev/documentation/layout-examples): Sample layout files
- [Swap layouts](https://zellij.dev/documentation/swap-layouts): Alternate layouts for a session
- [Themes](https://zellij.dev/documentation/themes): Theming Zellij
- [Theme list](https://zellij.dev/documentation/theme-list): Community theme showcase
- [Session resurrection](https://zellij.dev/documentation/session-resurrection): Restoring closed sessions
- [Web client](https://zellij.dev/documentation/web-client): Accessing Zellij sessions from a browser
- [Controlling Zellij through the CLI](https://zellij.dev/documentation/controlling-zellij-through-cli): Scripting Zellij actions
- [CLI actions](https://zellij.dev/documentation/cli-actions): Available `zellij action` subcommands
- [CLI commands](https://zellij.dev/documentation/commands): Top-level CLI command reference
- [Programmatic control](https://zellij.dev/documentation/programmatic-control): Driving Zellij from scripts/other programs
- [Plugins overview](https://zellij.dev/documentation/plugins): Zellij's WASM plugin system
- [Plugin development](https://zellij.dev/documentation/plugin-development): Writing your own plugins
- [Plugin API](https://zellij.dev/documentation/plugin-api): Full plugin API reference
- [Compatibility](https://zellij.dev/documentation/compatibility): Terminal/OS compatibility notes
- [Migrating YAML config](https://zellij.dev/documentation/migrating-yaml-config): Upgrading from the legacy YAML config format
- [Migrating YAML layouts](https://zellij.dev/documentation/migrating-yaml-layouts): Upgrading legacy YAML layouts
